items.title: Isaiah "Ike" Robinson Interview, 1961-04-28
items.q: He wasn't quite full as son Henry was from Magnolia.

ctx.x: Maybe he told us, I forgot. He told us where he was born.
Oh, I beg your pardon. He wasn't quite full as son Henry was from Magnolia. Yeah. He was between Magnolia and this other big farm he had he got down there. I just remember.
Jim says he came from Deer Range I think. Yeah.
